title: A Hybrid Approach for Automated Security Pattern Recovery
title_zh: 一种用于自动化安全模式恢复的混合方法

paragraphs.en: Security-by-design emphasises integrating security into software design and development. Security pattern catalogues operationalise this principle by prescribing reusable architectural solutions to recurring security problems. However, recovering their implementations from source code remains challenging because security patterns are abstract, span multiple components, and admit many valid implementations. We present SecPatRec, a hybrid approach for automated security pattern recovery from source code repositories. We treat a security pattern as a reference architecture and frame its recovery as a deductive task: determining which prescribed roles are present, grounding them in code entities, and recovering their interaction sequences. SecPatRec pairs a ReAct-style LLM agent equipped with semantic and lexical code search for role detection and grounding with static code property graph analysis for interaction recovery. We curate a human-validated ground-truth dataset of 100 pattern instances covering five security patterns across 93 open-source Java and Python repositories, and introduce a three-level evaluation framework measuring recovery correctness against this ground truth. We evaluate SecPatRec using four LLMs, including proprietary and open-source models. Averaged over all models and pattern instances, SecPatRec achieves role-detection accuracy of 0.84, role-grounding similarity of 0.84, and an interaction-recovery score of 0.66. Compared to a one-shot end-to-end LLM baseline, SecPatRec achieves higher aggregate recovery scores and lower estimated LLM API costs per run, while processing repositories that exceed the baseline’s configured input limit. The recovered role mappings and statically derived interaction sequences provide structural and behavioural evidence that can support inspection of security-pattern implementations.

paragraphs.en: Software vulnerabilities can arise from weaknesses in a system’s design as well as from implementation mistakes. McGraw estimates that roughly half of software security defects are design flaws [ 1 ] , not implementation bugs [ 2 ] . Security-by-design emphasises integrating security into software design and development [ 2 , 3 ] . The EU Cyber Resilience Act reinforces this goal by establishing cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements made available on the EU market [ 4 ] . Tracing architectural security decisions to their implementation supports inspection of whether the code reflects the intended design [ 5 ] . However, this inspection is difficult when developers have only a partial view of the security architecture [ 6 ] , or when architectural documentation is missing, outdated or inconsistent with the code [ 7 , 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 软件漏洞可能源于系统设计中的缺陷，也可能源于实现过程中的错误。 McGraw 估计，大约一半的软件安全缺陷是设计缺陷[ 1 ]，而非实现错误[ 2 ]。 安全设计（Security-by-design）强调将安全融入软件设计与开发过程[ 2 , 3 ]。 欧盟《网络弹性法案》通过为在欧盟市场上投放的具有数字元素的产品确立网络安全要求，强化了这一目标[ 4 ]。 将架构层面的安全决策追溯至其实现，有助于检查代码是否反映了预期的设计[ 5 ]。 然而，当开发人员只能看到安全架构的部分视图[ 6 ]，或当架构文档缺失、过时或与代码不一致[ 7 , 8 ]时，这种检查就变得困难。

paragraphs.en: Security patterns are one of the primary means of security-by-design: they document reusable architectural solutions to recurring security problems [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . A pattern describes a solution through architectural roles and the actions between them, providing both a blueprint for implementing a security control and a reference for inspecting an existing implementation. Unlike the Gang of Four design patterns [ 12 ] , which offer code-level guidelines, security patterns admit multiple valid implementations. A role may be realised through different classes, functions or library calls, depending on the language, framework and application context [ 13 , 14 , 11 ] , and an implementation may span several components. Consequently, finding individual security mechanisms does not establish how the pattern is implemented. Recovering the roles and their interactions can support architectural inspection and enable larger-scale empirical studies of how security patterns are used in practice, for which evidence remains limited [ 15 , 16 ] .

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we address automated security pattern recovery : given a security pattern and a codebase, determine which prescribed roles are present, ground them in code entities, and recover their interaction sequence. Because a security pattern describes both structure and behaviour, we treat it as a reference architecture and frame recovery as a deductive software architecture recovery (DSAR) task [ 17 ] . The pattern specification guides the search for implementing entities, including code defined within the repository and references to externally defined functionality.

paragraphs.en: Three challenges motivate our approach. First, roles are implemented in many ways. Prior work detects security patterns by architectural analysis and pattern matching [ 18 , 19 ] ; Bunke and Sohr, for example, match connected object process graphs and evaluate on a benchmark of Android applications [ 20 ] . LLM-assisted DSAR adds a different ability: it finds code units by what they mean rather than by their structure [ 17 , 21 ] . We ask whether this can detect and ground roles in Java and Python repositories too large for a single prompt. Second, role mappings alone are not enough. They say which entities play the roles, not how those entities interact, and LLM-assisted DSAR only supports the mapping [ 17 , 21 ] . Static analysis can supply the call relationships and their order. Third, each recovery output needs its own measure. Although architecture-level similarity measures provide useful comparisons of recovered architectures [ 22 , 23 ] , evaluating individual patterns requires measurements linked to role presence, code grounding and interaction recovery. Assessing these outputs and comparing recovery configurations requires human-validated annotations at this granularity, which we construct.
paragraphs.zh: 三个挑战推动了我们的方法。 首先，角色有多种实现方式。 已有工作通过架构分析和模式匹配来检测安全模式 [ 18 , 19 ] ；例如，Bunke 和 Sohr 通过匹配连接对象过程图，并在一个 Android 应用基准上进行评估 [ 20 ] 。 LLM 辅助的 DSAR 增添了不同的能力：它依据代码单元的含义而非结构来发现代码单元 [ 17 , 21 ] 。 我们探究这种方法是否也能在单个提示词无法容纳的超大 Java 和 Python 代码库中检测角色并将其落实到代码。 其次，仅有角色映射是不够的。 它们只说明哪些实体扮演这些角色，而不说明这些实体如何交互，而 LLM 辅助的 DSAR 只支持映射 [ 17 , 21 ] 。 静态分析可以提供调用关系及其顺序。 第三，每个恢复输出都需要其专属的度量。 尽管架构级相似度度量为恢复出的架构提供了有用的比较 [ 22 , 23 ] ，但评估单个模式需要与角色存在性、代码落实和交互恢复相关联的度量。 评估这些输出并比较不同的恢复配置需要这一粒度上经人工验证的标注，我们构建了这样的标注。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose SecPatRec , a hybrid approach that combines an LLM agent with static code property graph (CPG) analysis [ 24 ] . Guided by the pattern specification, the agent iteratively uses semantic and lexical code search to locate and inspect relevant code, producing role mappings and presence statuses. CPG traversal then uses these mappings to recover interactions between the identified entities. This division combines semantic interpretation of architectural roles with interaction evidence extracted from source code. To evaluate the approach, we construct human-validated ground truth and define three corresponding correctness metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 SecPatRec，一种将 LLM 智能体与静态代码属性图（CPG）分析 [24] 相结合的混合方法。 在模式规范的引导下，智能体迭代地使用语义和词法代码搜索来定位并检查相关代码，生成角色映射和存在状态。 随后，CPG 遍历利用这些映射来恢复已识别实体之间的交互。 这种分工将架构角色的语义解释与从源代码中提取的交互证据结合起来。 为评估该方法，我们构建了经人工验证的基准真值，并定义了三个相应的正确性指标。

paragraphs.en: An empirical evaluation using four LLMs, including proprietary and open-source models, across five patterns and two languages. We compare SecPatRec with a one-shot end-to-end LLM baseline, examine scalability with repository size, and assess how the code search tools affect correctness, token consumption and estimated LLM API costs.

paragraphs.en: Over the four models and all evaluated pattern instances, SecPatRec achieves a mean role detection accuracy of 0.84, a mean mapping localization score of 0.84 and a mean interaction recovery correctness of 0.66. paragraphs.en: Security patterns document reusable solutions to recurring security problems that occur in a particular security context [ 25 , 10 , 26 ] . We use the catalogue of Van Den Berghe et al. [ 11 ] , published online by KU Leuven’s DistriNet group 1 1 1 https://securitypatterns.distrinet-research.be/patterns/ , because it describes patterns through a common metamodel 2 2 2 https://securitypatterns.distrinet-research.be/metamodel/ . Each solution specifies the participating roles , the actions they perform, the data elements they exchange, and their behaviour . Roles represent entities or specialised entity types, such as enforcement points, decision points, storage and cryptographic primitives. Behaviour is described through a walkthrough and a diagram whose numbered interactions convey ordering information. The catalogue also provides coverage mappings to security-risk lists, including the OWASP Top 10 (2021).

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 presents an adapted view of the successful authentication flow of Password-based authentication 3 3 3 https://securitypatterns.distrinet-research.be/patterns/01_01_002__authentication_pwd/ . The Subject sends an identifier and password to the Enforcer ( b 1 b_{1} ), which forwards them to the Verification manager ( b 2 b_{2} ). The Verification manager retrieves the stored password-verification value and its salt from the Password store ( b 3 b_{3} ), and requests a hash of the submitted password using that salt from the Hasher ( b 4 b_{4} ). In the peppered variant illustrated by the catalogue, it then retrieves the pepper ( b 5 b_{5} ), uses the Encrypter to encrypt the calculated hash with the pepper as the cryptographic key ( b 6 b_{6} ). The verification manager sends the resulting ciphertext and the stored password-verification value to the Comparator, which compares them with the stored value and returns the verification result ( b 7 b_{7} ). Following successful verification, the Enforcer forwards the request to the System ( b 8 b_{8} ), which may reply to the Subject ( b 9 b_{9} ). Intermediate replies and the failure branch are omitted from the figure.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了基于密码的身份认证成功流程的改编视图 3 3 3 https://securitypatterns.distrinet-research.be/patterns/01_01_002__authentication_pwd/ 。 主体向执行者发送标识符和密码（ b 1 b_{1} ），执行者将它们转发给验证管理器（ b 2 b_{2} ）。 验证管理器从密码存储中获取存储的密码验证值及其盐值（ b 3 b_{3} ），并向哈希器请求使用该盐值对提交的密码进行哈希（ b 4 b_{4} ）。 在图录所示的加胡椒变体中，验证管理器随后获取胡椒值（ b 5 b_{5} ），并使用加密器以该胡椒值作为加密密钥对计算得到的哈希值进行加密（ b 6 b_{6} ）。 验证管理器将生成的密文和存储的密码验证值发送给比较器，比较器将它们与存储的值进行比较并返回验证结果（ b 7 b_{7} ）。 验证成功后，执行者将请求转发给系统（ b 8 b_{8} ），系统可向主体回复（ b 9 b_{9} ）。 中间回复和失败分支在图中被省略。

paragraphs.en: The catalogue describes security responsibilities and interactions without prescribing a unique code structure. Roles do not always correspond to distinct classes, functions or modules, and a library operation may realise several roles. For example, Figure 2 maps the Enforcer, Verification manager and Password store to three functions in a simplified FastAPI login handler, and maps the Comparator to an externally defined passlib password-verification call. Additional responsibilities, such as password hashing, may be encapsulated by the same call. The handler contains no explicit peppering step. Recovering a role therefore requires interpreting the available code and library references in context [ 13 , 14 ] . Section III formalises the recovery outputs and their presence statuses.
paragraphs.zh: 该目录描述了安全职责及其交互，而不规定唯一的代码结构。 角色并不总是对应于不同的类、函数或模块，一个库操作可能实现多个角色。 例如，图 2 将 Enforcer（执行者）、Verification manager（验证管理器）和 Password store（密码存储）映射到简化的 FastAPI 登录处理程序中的三个函数，并将 Comparator（比较器）映射到外部定义的 passlib 密码验证调用。 其他职责，如密码哈希，可能由同一个调用封装。 该处理程序不包含显式的加椒（peppering）步骤。 因此，恢复角色需要结合上下文解释可用的代码和库引用 [ 13 , 14 ] 。 第 III 节形式化了恢复输出及其存在状态。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, our goal is to recover the architectural components of security patterns from existing codebases. The target catalogue is the Van den Berghe’s developed by KU Leuven’s Distrinet group [ 11 ] . We observe that security patterns in the Van den Berghe’s catalogue express both the structural properties and the behavioral properties of a security architecture [ 27 , 28 ] . As a result, mining a reference security pattern from a codebase can be approached as a deductive software architecture recovery (DSAR) problem [ 17 , 21 ] , focusing on the tasks of matching architectural roles that the pattern prescribes to specific classes or functions, and to derive the sequence of interactions between the matched roles. We formulate this problem as follow:
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们的目标是从现有代码库中恢复安全模式的体系结构组件。 目标目录是由鲁汶大学（KU Leuven）Distrinet 研究组开发的 Van den Berghe 目录 [ 11 ] 。 我们观察到，Van den Berghe 目录中的安全模式既表达了安全体系结构的结构属性，也表达了其行为属性 [ 27 , 28 ] 。 因此，从代码库中挖掘参考安全模式可以被视为一个演绎式软件体系结构恢复（DSAR）问题 [ 17 , 21 ] ，其重点在于两项任务：将模式所规定的体系结构角色匹配到具体的类或函数，并推导出被匹配角色之间的交互序列。 我们将该问题表述如下：

paragraphs.en: A security pattern, or pattern is specified as a tuple P = ( R , B ) P=(R,B) , where:
paragraphs.zh: 安全模式（security pattern），或称模式（pattern），被定义为一个元组 P = ( R , B ) P=(R,B)，其中：

paragraphs.en: Roles ( R R ): A vocabulary R = { r 1 , … , r m } R=\{r_{1},\ldots,r_{m}\} of prescribed architectural entities. For example, a password-based authentication pattern might prescribe R = { Enforcer , Verification manager , Hasher , Password store } R=\{\text{\emph{Enforcer}},\text{\emph{Verification manager}},\text{\emph{Hasher}},\text{\emph{Password store}}\} .
paragraphs.zh: 角色（R）：一个由预先规定的架构实体构成的词汇表 R = {r₁, …, rₘ}。 例如，一个基于密码的认证模式可能规定 R = {Enforcer（强制者）、Verification manager（验证管理者）、Hasher（哈希器）、Password store（密码存储库）}。

sents.en: Roles ( R R ): A vocabulary R = { r 1 , … , r m } R=\{r_{1},\ldots,r_{m}\} of prescribed architectural entities.
sents.zh: 角色（R）：一个由预先规定的架构实体构成的词汇表 R = {r₁, …, rₘ}。

sents.en: For example, a password-based authentication pattern might prescribe R = { Enforcer , Verification manager , Hasher , Password store } R=\{\text{\emph{Enforcer}},\text{\emph{Verification manager}},\text{\emph{Hasher}},\text{\emph{Password store}}\} .

paragraphs.en: Actions ( B B ): An ordered sequence B = ⟨ b 1 , … , b n ⟩ B=\langle b_{1},\ldots,b_{n}\rangle dictating the behavioral flow between those roles.
paragraphs.zh: 动作（B B）：一个有序序列 B = ⟨ b 1 , … , b n ⟩ B=\langle b_{1},\ldots,b_{n}\rangle，规定了这些角色之间的行为流程。

paragraphs.en: The pattern itselfs can serves as the reference architecture to be recovered against a codebase C C . paragraphs.en: Our goal is to design an automated approach that can recover the architectural components of security patterns from existing codebases, including the role mapping M M , the presence statuses 𝒟 \mathcal{D} and the interaction sequence S S , using the pattern specification P P as the reference architecture for DSAR. Previous works in DSAR have shown that LLMs can be used for code unit classification effectively [ 17 , 21 ] , which is suitable for the task of generating candidate role mappings M ^ \hat{M} , and consequently the presence statuses 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} of the roles. However, for large real-world codebases, chunking all code symbols in ℰ ⁡ ( C ) \mathcal{E}(C) to feed into LLMs for batched classification tasks could be computationally expensive and time-consuming [ 31 ] , and at the same time losing repository-level global contexts as code symbols have been fragmented and processed individually [ 32 ] . Also, individual code unit classification can not be adopted for the next task of security pattern recovery, which is recovering a sequence of behaviorial interactions between the mapped roles.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的目标是设计一种自动化方法，能够从现有代码库中恢复安全模式的架构组件，包括角色映射 M M、存在状态 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 和交互序列 S S，并以模式规范 P P 作为 DSAR 的参考架构。 DSAR 领域的已有工作表明，大语言模型可以有效地用于代码单元分类 [ 17 , 21 ]，这适用于生成候选角色映射 M ^ \hat{M} 以及相应角色存在状态 𝒮 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} 的任务。 然而，对于大型真实代码库，将 ℰ ⁡ ( C ) \mathcal{E}(C) 中的所有代码符号分块输入大语言模型进行批量分类任务，计算开销大且耗时 [ 31 ]；同时，由于代码符号被碎片化并逐个处理，还会丢失仓库级的全局上下文 [ 32 ]。 此外，单个代码单元的分类也无法用于下一个任务，即安全模式恢复，也就是恢复被映射角色之间的行为交互序列。

paragraphs.en: To address the above challenges, we propose a hybrid approach that combines LLMs with code search methods and static code property graph (CPG) analysis [ 24 ] to recover the architectural components of Van De Berg’s security patterns from existing codebases. LLM that used chain-of-thought reasoning with code search as external tools is suitable for the tasks of security pattern roles’ detection and mapping, which requires iterative localization of relevant code contexts from a large source global semantic information [ 33 , 32 ] , while CPG analysis provides a deterministic way to bridge the mapped roles and their interactions. paragraphs.en: Translate Pattern Specification into Architecture Description Language Code The pattern specification P P from the Van De Berg [ 11 ] ,is documented as textual descriptions in Markdown format and PNG images of their corresponding UML diagrams. We want to translate these information into a reference architecture description language (ADL) code to guide the LLM chain-of-thought reasoning in the role mapping and presence detection tasks. This translation is done by our developed ADL code generator, which provides Mermaid and JSON code representation of the prescribed roles and their interactions. Details on how we implement this translation are provided in Appendix A-A . The generated ADL code is then used to construct a prompt for the LLM to perform the role mapping and presence detection tasks.

paragraphs.en: Iterative Tool-assisted CoT Role Detection and Mapping We perform role detection and mapping with ReAct [ 34 ] , an iterative reasoning method that lets an LLM interleave chain-of-thought with calls to external tools. At each iteration, the LLM first writes a Thought about what it has learned so far from a codebase and what to look for next, then issues one Action , i.e., a call to external code search tools, or trigger particular file reads and finally reads the Observation , a code context returned by that specific tool call. The iterations continue until the LLM has detected and mapped every role of P P . The system prompts for this process is inserted with the previously translated JSON ADL code to guide the reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代式工具辅助的思维链角色检测与映射 我们使用 ReAct [34] 进行角色检测与映射，这是一种迭代推理方法，允许大语言模型在思维链与外部工具调用之间交替进行。 在每次迭代中，大语言模型首先写下一段 Thought（思考），总结它目前从代码库中学到的内容以及下一步要查找的方向，然后发出一个 Action（动作），即调用外部代码搜索工具或触发特定文件的读取，最后读取 Observation（观察结果），即该特定工具调用返回的代码上下文。 迭代持续进行，直到大语言模型检测并映射了 P P 的每一个角色。 该过程的系统提示中插入了先前翻译好的 JSON ADL 代码，以引导推理。

paragraphs.en: The LLM explores the codebase C C through two search methods. Semantic search takes a description in natural language and returns a code symbols in C C . We vectorize every symbol with BGE-small [ 35 ] 4 4 4 Checkpoint BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 , https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 . , and then store them in ChromaDB for later retrieval triggers. Lexical search , instead, finds a literal string or a regular expression anywhere in the repository and returns the matching lines with their file and line number. The combination of 2 search methods allows the LLM to both semantically and syntatically locate and analyze relevant code elements [ 33 , 36 ] . The LLM can also list directories and read files to inspect what code searches return.The final output of this task is a structural set of role mappings M ^ \hat{M} and theoir presence statuses 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} , which are passed on to the next task of recovering the interactions. Outputs of this stage are JSON files that contain the role mapping M ^ \hat{M} and the presence statuses 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} of the roles, formatted as in Figure 18 a in Appendix B .

paragraphs.en: The pattern-problem pairs in Van De Berg’s catalogue are developed with the aims to cover OWASP Top 10 security risks in web application 7 7 7 https://securitypatterns.distrinet-research.be/coverage/ . As a result, we want to use real-world open-source codebase that implements security control for web applications for validation our approach. We use our custom tool 8 8 8 https://github.com/username/repo to automate the cloning of 93 repositories from Github. The choice of repositories is based on the condition that they depend on 2 corresponding web security frameworks: Python’s FastAPI and Java’s Springboot Security. The selection of FastAPI and Spring Boot was driven by their widespread adoption; as of 2025, they are used by 38% and 65% of their respective developer communities [ 37 , 38 ] . The target patterns used as reference architectures are P1 Password-based authentication, P2 Verifiable-token authentication, P3 Obscure-token access control, P4 Session-based access control and P5 Rate limiting. They all belong the set of security solutions that tackle the security problems related to OWASP’s Top 10 2025: A01: Broken Access Control and A07: Authentication Failures [ 39 ] .

paragraphs.en: Obtaining groundtruth for software architecture recovery is inherently difficult, as knowledge of the system architects who designed the architecture is rarely available [ 29 , 22 ] . As a result, previous works [ 23 , 29 , 22 ] had to rely on authorative protocol , in which an automated process is used to generate a set of preliminary architectures , and then external human engineers are used to certify them. In this work, we follow a similar approach, but instead use Claude Code to generate a the preliminary role mappings M M and presence statuses 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , then have human experts verify them. This human-AI collaboration annotation approach is also used in previous software engineering and mining software repositories works [ 40 , 41 ] . We share our working session of how we use Claude Code to generate preliminary mappings in Appendix D . We then traverse the CPGs to deterministically recover the preliminary interaction sequence S S among provided preliminary M M , using the same traversal rule as mentioned in III-B2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为软件架构恢复获取真值（groundtruth）本质上是困难的，因为设计该架构的系统架构师的知识很少可得 [ 29 , 22 ] 。 因此，先前的工作 [ 23 , 29 , 22 ] 不得不依赖权威协议，即先用自动化过程生成一组初步架构，再由外部人类工程师对其进行认证。 在本工作中，我们采用类似的方法，但改用 Claude Code 来生成初步角色映射 M M 和在场状态 𝒟 \mathcal{D} ，然后由人类专家进行验证。 这种人机协作标注方法在此前的软件工程与软件仓库挖掘工作中也有使用 [ 40 , 41 ] 。 我们在附录 D 中分享了使用 Claude Code 生成初步映射的工作会话记录。 随后，我们遍历 CPG，在给定初步 M M 的情况下，按照 III-B2 中所述的相同遍历规则，确定性地恢复初步交互序列 S S 。

paragraphs.en: To help human annotators verify the preliminary architectures, we provide them with a web-based interface that allows them to inspect the preliminary role mappings and presence statuses, visualizing the candidate interaction sequence recovered, allowing annotators to trace the interactions between the mapped roles and code entities. Annotators are provided with the original Van de Berg’s catalogue for reference. They can approve or reject, or modify each preliminary roles mapping and interaction themselves if they think that existing recovery do not reflect the design that the orginal pattern intended. They can also map a single codebase with more than one security patterns, as in real-world open-source projects, developers can apply multiple security solutions to a single codebase [ 14 ] . We have two annotators, both of whom are senior software engineers that has more than 4 years of web application development. paragraphs.en: For each task of security pattern recovery, we define task-specific performance indicator to measure the correctness of our approach. We define one metric for each output of the recovery, comparing the presence statuses 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} with 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , the role mapping M ^ \hat{M} with M M , and the interaction sequence S ^ \hat{S} with S S . We call them role detection accuracy ( RDA ), mapping localization score ( MLS ) and interaction recovery correctness ( IRC ). A metric is computed for one recovery instance, i.e., one pattern recovered from one codebase, and is then averaged over all instances. The implmentation of our evaluation metrics is available in our repository 11 11 11 https://github.com/anonymousspottedtoad/secpat_evaluation_metrics . Appendix A-D shows the three metrics on a small example (Figures 16 and 17 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于安全模式恢复的每一项任务，我们定义了任务特定的性能指标来衡量我们方法的正确性。 我们为恢复的每项输出定义一个指标，将存在状态 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} 与 𝒟 \mathcal{D} 、角色映射 M ^ \hat{M} 与 M M 、以及交互序列 S ^ \hat{S} 与 S S 进行比较。 我们将其分别称为角色检测准确率（RDA）、映射定位得分（MLS）和交互恢复正确性（IRC）。 每个指标针对一个恢复实例计算，即从一个代码库中恢复出的一个模式，然后对所有实例取平均值。 我们评估指标的实现可在我们的仓库 11 11 11 https://github.com/anonymousspottedtoad/secpat_evaluation_metrics 中获取。 附录 A-D 在一个小示例上展示了这三个指标（图 16 和图 17）。

paragraphs.en: We choose our set of LLMs to evaluate on based on their benchmarked performace in full-stack web development tasks, since we want to make sure that they have been exposed to modern web security libraries that the groundtruth dataset is built on. Based on the top 20 results from CodeArena’s WebDev benchmark 12 12 12 https://arena.ai/leaderboard/code/webdev , we select the following 4 LLMs for evaluation: OpenAI’s GPT 6.1 Sol, Meta’s Muse Spark, Deepseek-v4.0-Flash-0731, and GLM-5.3. GPT and Muse are propietary LLMs, so we use their API endpoints to call them. Deepseek and GLM are open-source LLMs, so we host them on our cloud server with 2x NVIDIA’s B200 GPUs and 3x B300 GPUs on ModalAI’s infrastructure. We use the same prompt template for all LLMs, and the maximum tokens that all 4 LLMs can process are set to 1,000,000 tokens. Each LLM is run once per instance and setting, with a temperature of 0.7.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据全栈网页开发任务的基准测试表现来选择要评估的大语言模型集合，因为我们希望确保它们接触过构建基准真值数据集所依赖的现代网页安全库。 基于 CodeArena 的 WebDev 基准榜单前 20 的结果 12 12 12 https://arena.ai/leaderboard/code/webdev ，我们选出以下 4 个大语言模型进行评估：OpenAI 的 GPT 6.1 Sol、Meta 的 Muse Spark、Deepseek-v4.0-Flash-0731 以及 GLM-5.3。 GPT 和 Muse 是专有大语言模型，因此我们通过它们的 API 端点来调用。 Deepseek 和 GLM 是开源大语言模型，因此我们在 ModalAI 的基础设施上，使用配备 2 块 NVIDIA B200 GPU 和 3 块 B300 GPU 的云服务器来托管它们。 我们对所有大语言模型使用相同的提示模板，并且将所有 4 个大语言模型可处理的最大 token 数设为 1,000,000 个 token。 每个大语言模型在每个实例和每种设置下运行一次，温度设为 0.7。

paragraphs.en: Overall, we find that the LLMs perform well on the task of pattern role’s presence detection, with an average RDA (over the 100 instances) between 0.79 and 0.86. GLM and DeepSeek are the best performing LLMs on this task, both with an average RDA score of 0.86, while GPT-6.1 has the lowest one (0.79). Looking at the confustion matrix in 4 , we find that GPT-6.1, compared to other LLMs, is more likely to flag a role as missing when it is actually present, or called from an external library. This could be due to the fact that GPT-6.1 is more conservative in its predictions, and prefers to caution when it is not sure about the presence of a security-related component, or when it lacks the knowledge of a specific security library usage that is used in the codebase.

paragraphs.en: Looking at Figure 37 in Appendix E , we find that SecPatRec outperforms the baseline run in most patterns, partly because the baseline cannot run on the 16 codebases over its input limit, which score 0. On the 84 codebases both can run, the baseline is ahead in 21 of the 60 cases (five patterns, four LLMs and three metrics), mostly on RDA (9 cases), while our pipeline still has a higher overall IRC for every LLM (Table IX in Appendix E ). However, we find that all models perform the worst in P4 Session-based access control, where their IRC (0.37 to 0.58) is the lowest among all five patterns, and is even lower in the case of Java (0.16 to 0.46). This is due to the fact that in Springboot, the Authorization Enforcer is not called by the Authentication Enforcer in the codebase: it is declared as an annotation (e.g., @PreAuthorize ), and the Spring framework applies it at run time, after the Authentication Enforcer passes the request on (see Appendix F-A ). As no call in the source code links the two enforcers, the CPG analysis cannot find the interactions between them, which leads to a low IRC score. That’s why in P4 in Java, the baseline recovers the interactions better than our solution for most LLMs (three of four, e.g., 0.35 against 0.16 for GLM), as the baseline LLMs hallucinate the interaction order themselves, while SecPatRec can only recover the interactions existing inside the static CPG.

paragraphs.en: Figures 38 and 39 in Appendix E show the token cost side of scalability. The one-shot baseline has to read the whole codebase, so its token cost grows almost in proportion to the codebase size, where a ten times larger codebase costs 7 to 10 times more tokens, compared to only 1.2 to 1.9 times in SecPatRec, because the LLM only need to reads what the code search tools returns. The SecPatRec pipeline is therefore cheaper than the baseline for every codebase above 9k to 36k tokens, depending on the LLM, and at 1M tokens it is 6 (Muse-Spark) to 60 (GPT-6.1) times cheaper.

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows how recovery correctness changes with respect to codebase size. The RDA and MLS of SecPatRec do not decrease as codebases grow, while those number for the baseline drops dramatically, due to the size of 16 codebase exceeding the LLM’s token limit. For interaction recovery task, looking at Figure 40 in Appendix E , when every role is mapped to exactly the right symbol from previous steps (MLS = 1 =1 , 80 instances), the CPG analyzer in SecPatRec recovers the interaction sequence perfectly (IRC = 1 =1 ) on 73 of them, 0.93 on average, against 12% to 38% perfect instances in every lower MLS band. The CPG static analysis therefore scales with the codebase size.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 展示了恢复正确性如何随代码库规模变化。 SecPatRec 的 RDA 和 MLS 不会随代码库增大而下降，而基线方法的这些指标急剧下降，这是因为 16 个代码库的规模超过了 LLM 的 token 上限。 对于交互恢复任务，查看附录 E 中的图 40，当每个角色在前序步骤中都被映射到完全正确的符号时（MLS = 1 =1，共 80 个实例），SecPatRec 中的 CPG 分析器在其中 73 个实例上完美恢复了交互序列（IRC = 1 =1），平均为 0.93，而在每个更低的 MLS 区间中，完美实例的比例仅为 12% 到 38%。 因此，CPG 静态分析可以随代码库规模进行扩展。

paragraphs.en: Table X in Appendix E shows how the recovery changes when one search tool is removed from the LLM-based mapping stage. Removing either tool changes RDA and MLS by less than 0.03 for every LLM. To understand why, we counted the tool calls in every run. With both tools available, DeepSeek, GLM and Muse-Spark use keyword search for 80 to 93% of their searches, while GPT-6.1 uses the two about equally (46 to 52%). When one tool is removed, its calls move almost one for one to the other tool, and the number of steps per run changes by about one at most. The ReAct loop thus treats keyword and semantic search as interchangeable ways to find candidate code entities, which is why removing either of them, even the one an LLM prefers, does not hurt the recovery.

paragraphs.en: The RDA and MLS of SecPatRec stay flat as codebases grow (Figure 5 ), and when the roles are mapped exactly, the CPG traversal recovers the interaction sequence perfectly in 73 of 80 instances. Most of the IRC error therefore comes from the mapping stage, not from the traversal. It also means that improving role mapping is the key to improving our approach.

paragraphs.en: The CPG only contains the calls written in the source code, so it cannot see the interactions that only appear at run time, such as Spring’s @PreAuthorize , Spring’s bean injection, or FastAPI’s Depends . This is why the one-shot baseline has a higher IRC than SecPatRec on P4 in Java. However, the baseline cannot observe this order in the code either, as it invents the order from its knowledge of Spring, so its higher IRC is not a better recovery. We leave reading the framework’s configuration and annotations as future work.

paragraphs.en: We recommend GLM for low-cost recovery, as it costs about $0.005 per run and matches the other LLMs on RDA (0.86) and MLS (0.84). GPT-6.1 is the best choice when the interaction sequence or exact mappings matter, with the highest IRC (0.72) and the most exact mappings (27 of 100), but at about 8 to 10 times the cost of GLM. It is also the most conservative LLM: it reports 48% of the external roles as missing, but it overclaims the least, reporting only 18% of the missing roles as present or external, against 30% to 34% for the others.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation covers two languages, two frameworks (FastAPI and Spring Security), and five authentication and access control patterns (A01 and A07) from one catalogue, on repositories selected by their dependency on these frameworks. Within this scope, the Java repositories are larger and externalise more roles than the Python ones, so the two languages are not directly comparable. We do not yet investigate how the approach performs on other pattern in the Van De Berg’s catalogues, or on other web frameworks such as Django or Express, or on languages for which we have no traversal rules, but will consider that in future works. Our two annotators are experienced web developers rather than the architects of the systems, which is the standard limitation of groundtruths built with an authoritative protocol [ 29 ] .

paragraphs.en: Software architecture recovery is a well-studied field [ 22 , 43 ] , but existing methods are hard to adapt to security pattern recovery. Traditional static methods cluster code entities with human-specified graph rules [ 44 , 45 , 46 ] , which limits their generalizability to modern codebases across languages and libraries. Learning-based methods learn the representation of code entities [ 47 ] or semantic features of their dependency graphs [ 48 , 49 ] , which partially solves generalization, but still gives an inductive view of the architecture, not suitable for security patterns, which are prescriptive and enforceable.
paragraphs.zh: 软件架构恢复是一个研究充分的领域 [22, 43]，但现有方法难以适配到安全模式恢复中。 传统的静态方法使用人工指定的图规则对代码实体进行聚类 [44, 45, 46]，这限制了其在跨语言、跨库的现代代码库中的泛化能力。 基于学习的方法学习代码实体的表示 [47] 或其依赖图的语义特征 [48, 49]，这在一定程度上解决了泛化问题，但仍然给出的是架构的归纳性视图，不适合于具有规定性和可执行性的安全模式。

sents.en: Software architecture recovery is a well-studied field [ 22 , 43 ] , but existing methods are hard to adapt to security pattern recovery.
sents.zh: 软件架构恢复是一个研究充分的领域 [22, 43]，但现有方法难以适配到安全模式恢复中。

sents.en: Traditional static methods cluster code entities with human-specified graph rules [ 44 , 45 , 46 ] , which limits their generalizability to modern codebases across languages and libraries.
sents.zh: 传统的静态方法使用人工指定的图规则对代码实体进行聚类 [44, 45, 46]，这限制了其在跨语言、跨库的现代代码库中的泛化能力。

sents.en: Learning-based methods learn the representation of code entities [ 47 ] or semantic features of their dependency graphs [ 48 , 49 ] , which partially solves generalization, but still gives an inductive view of the architecture, not suitable for security patterns, which are prescriptive and enforceable.
sents.zh: 基于学习的方法学习代码实体的表示 [47] 或其依赖图的语义特征 [48, 49]，这在一定程度上解决了泛化问题，但仍然给出的是架构的归纳性视图，不适合于具有规定性和可执行性的安全模式。

paragraphs.en: Deductive software architecture recovery instead leverages the reasoning of LLMs to recover the architecture of a codebase against a reference architecture [ 50 , 51 , 17 , 21 ] , which suits the prescriptive nature of security patterns. However, these works only recover the component view of the architecture, not the interaction view, which is crucial for security patterns. Our work is the first deductive approach that recovers both views of security patterns from source code, evaluated on a large dataset of real-world codebases.
paragraphs.zh: 演绎式软件架构恢复则利用大语言模型的推理能力，依据参考架构从代码库中恢复其架构 [50, 51, 17, 21]，这契合安全模式的规定性特征。 然而，这些工作仅恢复架构的组件视图，而未恢复对安全模式至关重要的交互视图。 我们的工作是首个能从源代码中同时恢复安全模式这两个视图的演绎式方法，并在大规模真实代码库数据集上进行了评估。

sents.en: Deductive software architecture recovery instead leverages the reasoning of LLMs to recover the architecture of a codebase against a reference architecture [ 50 , 51 , 17 , 21 ] , which suits the prescriptive nature of security patterns.
sents.zh: 演绎式软件架构恢复则利用大语言模型的推理能力，依据参考架构从代码库中恢复其架构 [50, 51, 17, 21]，这契合安全模式的规定性特征。

sents.en: However, these works only recover the component view of the architecture, not the interaction view, which is crucial for security patterns.
sents.zh: 然而，这些工作仅恢复架构的组件视图，而未恢复对安全模式至关重要的交互视图。

sents.en: Our work is the first deductive approach that recovers both views of security patterns from source code, evaluated on a large dataset of real-world codebases.
sents.zh: 我们的工作是首个能从源代码中同时恢复安全模式这两个视图的演绎式方法，并在大规模真实代码库数据集上进行了评估。

paragraphs.en: To measure the correctness of automated architecture recovery, traditional cluster-based recovery methods rely on the distance between the recovered clusters and those of a groundtruth architecture [ 22 , 29 , 23 ] . Since our method is deductive, mapping the roles of a given pattern to code rather than grouping the code into clusters, these distance-based measures are not suitable for our evaluation. Other works focus on measuring architectural drift, to analyze whether an implementation conforms to its intended design or architecture [ 52 , 53 , 54 ] . Reflexion models, for example, compare an engineer’s high-level model with a model extracted from the source code, and report where the two diverge [ 5 ] . Pruijt et al. compare the accuracy of ten tools that check such conformance [ 55 ] , and commercial platforms such as Sonar also offer these checks, but they are proprietary and not open-source [ 56 ] . However, measuring conformance is also not suitable for our evaluation, as we measure the independent tasks of security pattern recovery, which we have divided into mapping security-relevant code [ 42 ] and arranging their interactions in sequence [ 57 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量自动化架构恢复的正确性，传统的基于聚类的恢复方法依赖于恢复出的聚类与基准架构（groundtruth）的聚类之间的距离 [22, 29, 23]。 由于我们的方法是演绎式的，即将给定模式的角色映射到代码，而不是将代码分组为聚类，因此这些基于距离的度量不适合我们的评估。 其他工作则侧重于衡量架构漂移，以分析某个实现是否符合其预期的设计或架构 [52, 53, 54]。 例如，反射模型将工程师的高层模型与从源代码中提取的模型进行比较，并报告两者出现分歧之处 [5]。 Pruijt 等人比较了十个检查此类符合性的工具的准确性 [55]，Sonar 等商业平台也提供这些检查，但它们是专有的且非开源 [56]。 然而，衡量符合性也不适合我们的评估，因为我们衡量的是安全模式恢复的独立任务，我们将其划分为映射安全相关代码 [42] 以及按顺序安排它们的交互 [57]。

paragraphs.en: Works on mining security architectural tactics are close to ours, as they share our motivation of mining the architecture-relevant code that enables the security properties of software [ 58 , 59 , 60 ] . Mirakhorli and Cleland-Huang detect tactic-related code in open-source systems and monitor it as the system evolves [ 58 ] . Mujhid et al. build ArchEngine, a search engine that retrieves and ranks the code snippets implementing a given tactic [ 59 ] . Santos et al. catalogue 224 security architecture weaknesses, organized by the security tactics that address them [ 60 ] . Like SecPatRec, these works mine code with lexical code search, using API signatures as keywords. However, they do not attempt to tackle the mapping of the mined code snippets to the architectural components of the security tactics or patterns, which is the core of our recovery task.
paragraphs.zh: 有关挖掘安全架构战术的研究工作与我们的研究相近，因为它们与我们有相同的动机，即挖掘能够实现软件安全属性的架构相关代码 [ 58 , 59 , 60 ] 。 Mirakhorli 和 Cleland-Huang 在开源系统中检测与战术相关的代码，并在系统演化过程中对其进行监控 [ 58 ] 。 Mujhid 等人构建了 ArchEngine，这是一个搜索引擎，能够检索实现给定战术的代码片段并对其进行排序 [ 59 ] 。 Santos 等人编目了 224 种安全架构弱点，并按解决这些弱点的安全战术进行组织 [ 60 ] 。 与 SecPatRec 类似，这些工作使用词汇代码搜索来挖掘代码，并将 API 签名作为关键词。 然而，它们并未尝试解决将挖掘出的代码片段映射到安全战术或模式的架构组件这一问题，而这正是我们恢复任务的核心。

paragraphs.en: We presented SecPatRec , a hybrid approach to security pattern recovery that combines an LLM agent with code search for role mapping and CPG analysis for interaction recovery. On 100 instances across 93 Java and Python codebases, it achieves a mean RDA of 0.84, MLS of 0.84 and IRC of 0.66 over four LLMs, outperforming a one-shot LLM baseline at a cost that barely grows with codebase size. As the CPG analysis is nearly exact when the roles are mapped exactly, improving role mapping is the key to further improvement. Our dataset, metrics and pipeline can serve as a benchmark and an instrument for mining security patterns at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SecPatRec，一种混合式的安全模式恢复方法，它将一个智能体与代码搜索相结合以进行角色映射，并利用代码属性图（CPG）分析来恢复交互关系。 在来自 93 个 Java 和 Python 代码库的 100 个实例上，该方法在四个大语言模型上的平均 RDA 为 0.84、MLS 为 0.84、IRC 为 0.66，优于单次调用的大语言模型基线，且其成本几乎不随代码库规模增长。 由于在角色被精确映射时 CPG 分析结果几乎完全准确，改进角色映射是进一步提升性能的关键。 我们的数据集、指标和流程可作为大规模挖掘安全模式的基准测试和工具。

paragraphs.en: SecPatRec reads every security pattern through a single artefact, the specification P = ( R , B ) P=(R,B) . Security patterns, however, are documented in different ways: each catalogue represents a pattern’s structure in its own form of prose and diagrams [ 10 , 26 , 11 ] , which the pipeline cannot read directly. An ADL code generator is therefore needed to bring a pattern into the structure the pipeline understands. This appendix presents one such case: transforming the patterns of the KU Leuven catalogue [ 11 ] into P P . paragraphs.en: Each pattern of the KU Leuven catalogue is documented on one page, in the same parts:
paragraphs.zh: 鲁汶大学（KU Leuven）目录中的每个模式都在一页上进行文档化，包含相同的部分：

paragraphs.en: Name, Summary : what the pattern is and what it achieves.
paragraphs.zh: 名称、摘要：该模式是什么以及它实现了什么。

paragraphs.en: Parent, Problem : the general pattern it refines and the problem it solves.
paragraphs.zh: Parent, Problem : 它所精化的总体模式，以及它所解决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Roles : the participants, each with a metamodel type.
paragraphs.zh: Roles：参与者，每个参与者都有一个元模型类型。

paragraphs.en: Actions, Data elements : the calls and data the roles exchange.
paragraphs.zh: 动作、数据元素：各角色交换的调用和数据。

paragraphs.en: Behaviour : the interactions between roles, as numbered steps.
paragraphs.zh: 行为：角色之间的交互，以编号步骤呈现。

paragraphs.en: Diagram : the same interactions, drawn as boxes and numbered arrows.
paragraphs.zh: 图示：以方框和带编号的箭头绘制的相同交互。

paragraphs.en: Considerations, Implementations, References : design advice, example libraries and literature.
paragraphs.zh: 注意事项、实现方式、参考资料：设计建议、示例库与文献。

paragraphs.en: Our main concern is the pattern’s structure: the Name, Summary, Roles, Actions, Data elements, Behaviour and the diagram (Figure 7 ). The other parts guide a designer but define no role or interaction, so the generator keeps them only as context.

paragraphs.en: The generator turns these parts into P P in six stages (Figure 6 ). paragraphs.en: Split and select. A text-only call groups the edges by step-prefix family ( 1..N , Reg.* , Res.* ) into one sequence diagram each, and a second call keeps only the pattern’s primary runtime flow. For P1, this keeps the login flow (steps 1–15) and drops registration and reset, together with five roles no login invokes: the Registrar, Password policy, Hash manager, SRNG and Resetter.

paragraphs.en: Synthesise. A text-only call with reasoning emits P P from the page prose and the main flow: each role with its name, metamodel type, required flag and description, and each interaction with its from and to roles, call element and description. Its central rule is that an entry is an interaction, not an arrow : a response is folded into the request it answers, as a sentence of its description, so P1’s 16 arrows become the nine interactions b 1 , … , b 9 b_{1},\dots,b_{9} of Figure 1 (Figure A-A2 ). A returning edge that answers no request, such as the System’s reply to the Subject, keeps its own entry of kind data .
paragraphs.zh: 进行综合。 一次仅文本、带推理的调用会从页面正文和主流中生成 P P：每个角色都带有其名称、元模型类型、必填标志和描述，每个交互都带有其发起角色和目标角色、调用元素以及描述。 其核心规则是：一个条目是一个交互，而不是一条箭头——响应被折叠进它所回应的请求中，作为其描述中的一个句子，因此 P1 的 16 条箭头变成了图 1 中的九个交互 b 1 , … , b 9 b_{1},\dots,b_{9}（图 A-A2）。 未回应任何请求的返回边（例如系统对主体的回复）保留其类型为 data 的独立条目。

paragraphs.en: The one-shot baseline of Section V-C sends the LLM the system prompt of Figure A-C and one user message. The user message holds the specification P P and the whole repository, each between two tags: <pattern> P P </pattern> , followed by <repository> … </repository> , which lists the directory tree of the repository and then every source file, each marked with its path. The baseline has no tools: the LLM gives its whole answer, the role mapping and the interaction order, in one reply, and the same request is sent to every LLM. A request longer than 900K tokens, counted with the o200k_base tokenizer, is not sent; these are the 16 instances over the baseline’s input limit.
paragraphs.zh: 第 V-C 节的单次基线向大语言模型发送图 A-C 的系统提示词和一条用户消息。 用户消息包含规约 P P 和整个代码仓库，各置于两个标签之间：先是 <pattern> P P </pattern>，随后是 <repository> … </repository>，其中列出代码仓库的目录树，然后列出每个源文件，每个文件都标注其路径。 该基线没有任何工具：大语言模型在单次回复中给出其完整答案，即角色映射和交互顺序，并且相同的请求会发送给每个大语言模型。 超过 900K 词元（按 o200k_base 分词器统计）的请求不予发送；这些就是超出基线输入上限的 16 个实例。

paragraphs.en: To recover the interaction sequence S ^ \hat{S} , we traverse the code property graph (CPG) of the codebase C C from the code symbol e ^ \hat{e} that one role is mapped to, to the code symbols of the other roles, following the mappings m ^ = ( r , e ^ ) ∈ M ^ \hat{m}=(r,\hat{e})\in\hat{M} (Section III-B2 ). We build the CPG with Joern, which implements the CPG of Yamaguchi et al. [ 24 ] . This appendix first explains why the CPG that Joern builds is not enough for this task on its own (Appendix C-A ), and then how we added the missing links and defined our own traversal rules to move between the roles (Appendix C-B ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了恢复交互序列 S ^ \hat{S}，我们从某个角色所映射到的代码符号 e ^ \hat{e} 出发，依据映射 m ^ = ( r , e ^ ) ∈ M ^ \hat{m}=(r,\hat{e})\in\hat{M}（见第 III-B2 节），遍历代码库 C C 的代码属性图（CPG），直至到达其他角色的代码符号。 我们使用 Joern 构建 CPG，该工具实现了 Yamaguchi 等人 [24] 提出的 CPG。 本附录首先解释为什么 Joern 构建的 CPG 本身不足以完成此任务（见附录 C-A），然后说明我们如何添加缺失的链接并定义自己的遍历规则以在角色之间移动（见附录 C-B）。

paragraphs.en: In Joern’s CPG, every node is one piece of code, a method or a statement or expression inside it, with a type such as METHOD or CALL and properties such as name or fullName . Every edge also has a type, and our traversal follows the four kinds in Table IV . In the figures of this appendix, the code is on the left and the graph on the right, where each box is a node (its type in bold, its properties below) and each arrow an edge, labelled with its type.

paragraphs.en: The CPG is built per method. The control-flow edges, which give the order in which the code runs, never leave a method (Figure 19 ). The graph of a codebase is therefore a set of islands, one per method, and the only way from one island to another is a call edge. The code symbols e ^ \hat{e} that the roles r ∈ R r\in R are mapped to, however, are rarely in the same method, and often not in the same file, so recovering their interactions depends almost entirely on the call edges between methods across the codebase.
paragraphs.zh: CPG 按方法构建。 给出代码运行顺序的控制流边不会离开方法本身（图 19）。 因此，代码库的图是一组孤岛，每个方法一个孤岛，而从一个孤岛到另一个孤岛的唯一途径是调用边。 然而，角色 r ∈ R 所映射到的代码符号 e ^ 很少位于同一个方法中，而且往往不在同一个文件中，因此恢复它们的交互几乎完全依赖于整个代码库中方法之间的调用边。

sents.en: The CPG is built per method.
sents.zh: CPG 按方法构建。

sents.en: The control-flow edges, which give the order in which the code runs, never leave a method (Figure 19 ).
sents.zh: 给出代码运行顺序的控制流边不会离开方法本身（图 19）。

sents.en: The graph of a codebase is therefore a set of islands, one per method, and the only way from one island to another is a call edge.
sents.zh: 因此，代码库的图是一组孤岛，每个方法一个孤岛，而从一个孤岛到另一个孤岛的唯一途径是调用边。

sents.en: The code symbols e ^ \hat{e} that the roles r ∈ R r\in R are mapped to, however, are rarely in the same method, and often not in the same file, so recovering their interactions depends almost entirely on the call edges between methods across the codebase.
sents.zh: 然而，角色 r ∈ R 所映射到的代码符号 e ^ 很少位于同一个方法中，而且往往不在同一个文件中，因此恢复它们的交互几乎完全依赖于整个代码库中方法之间的调用边。

paragraphs.en: Call edges are often missing. Joern links a call to the method it runs through the address it infers for the call, methodFullName , with three possible outcomes (Figure 20 ): the call is linked to a method of the codebase, which we can traverse into; to a placeholder for a library method, which has no code; or to nothing at all. A call between two files of the same codebase often ends up in the second or third case, for example when the called function is re-exported by a Python package, or when Python gives no type for the object a method is called on. Joern also links a name to the variable it refers to (Figure 21 ), and a function passed as a value, such as a callback, to its method (Figure 22 ).
paragraphs.zh: 调用边常常是缺失的。 Joern 通过它为调用推断出的地址（methodFullName）将调用与其运行的方法链接起来，可能有三种结果（图 20）：调用被链接到代码库中的某个方法，我们可以深入遍历该方法；链接到库方法的占位符，该方法没有代码；或者什么都不链接。 同一代码库中两个文件之间的调用往往落入第二种或第三种情况，例如当被调用的函数被一个 Python 包重新导出时，或者当 Python 无法给出方法所调用对象的类型时。 Joern 还会将名称链接到它所引用的变量（图 21），并将作为值传递的函数（例如回调函数）链接到其对应的方法（图 22）。

paragraphs.en: The way a security control is implemented can hide its calls. Whether a call between two roles appears in the graph also depends on the libraries and frameworks the developers built the security control with. In Spring, the framework passes a login request to the codebase’s own provider inside library code, which is not in the graph, and builds the objects that roles call through @Bean methods; in FastAPI, a dependency declared as Depends(f) is called by the framework, and Joern’s Python frontend drops it from the graph altogether. In all these cases, two roles that do interact when the code runs have no path between them in Joern’s CPG, and a traversal of that graph alone misses their interaction. We therefore add the missing edges ourselves, as described next.
paragraphs.zh: 安全控制（security control）的实现方式可能会使其调用被隐藏。 两个角色之间的调用是否出现在图中，还取决于开发者构建安全控制时所使用的库和框架。 在 Spring 中，框架在库代码内将登录请求传递给代码库自身的 provider，而库代码不在图中，并通过 @Bean 方法构建角色所调用的对象；在 FastAPI 中，声明为 Depends(f) 的依赖由框架调用，而 Joern 的 Python 前端会将其从图中完全移除。 在所有这些情况下，代码运行时确实发生交互的两个角色，在 Joern 的 CPG 中之间却没有路径，仅遍历该图就会遗漏它们的交互。 因此，我们自行补上缺失的边，具体做法将在下文描述。

paragraphs.en: Where Joern’s graph lacks a link between two roles that interact, we add an edge of our own (Table V ). At a call, we always try Joern’s edge first and use ours only when Joern’s leads to no code of the codebase. We never add an edge by searching the codebase for a method with a matching name: an earlier version of our traversal did so, and on one codebase it recovered six interactions, five of them wrong, because one wrong link sends the traversal into unrelated code and every interaction found there is credited to the wrong role. Each case below comes with a short example: the code on the left, (a) Joern’s graph, where a red dashed arrow marks the missing link, and (b) the same graph with the edge we add (solid teal), where the shaded boxes are what we read to build it.

paragraphs.en: Joern sometimes gives a call to an imported function the wrong address. In Python, from auth import verify is read as the file auth.py ; when auth is a package that re-exports verify from auth/core.py , no method has that address, and the call is linked to a placeholder, as if it were a library call (Figure 26 a). Java statically imported methods have the same problem. The import statement of the calling file names the right method, so we follow it, through the re-export, to the file that defines it, and link the call there (Figure 26 b).

paragraphs.en: Spring code often calls a method on a library interface, such as authManager.authenticate(auth) , while at run time Spring supplies a class of the codebase that implements it. The interface’s code is not in the graph, so the call is linked to a placeholder (Figure 29 a). We find the classes of the codebase that implement the interface, directly or through a parent, and link the call to their method with the same name and number of parameters (Figure 29 b). We take at most one such step along a chain of helper calls, so that one guess is never built on another.
paragraphs.zh: Spring 代码经常调用库接口上的方法，例如 authManager.authenticate(auth)，而在运行时 Spring 会提供代码库中实现该接口的一个类。 接口的代码不在图中，因此该调用被链接到一个占位符（图 29 a）。 我们找出代码库中直接或通过父类实现该接口的类，并将该调用链接到它们中名称和参数个数都相同的方法（图 29 b）。 我们在辅助调用链上最多只采取这样的一步，从而使一个猜测永远不会建立在另一个猜测之上。

paragraphs.en: Some hand-offs happen entirely inside library code. A Spring Security login filter calls getAuthenticationManager().authenticate(req) , and Spring’s ProviderManager then passes the request to the codebase’s own AuthenticationProvider . The codebase does not implement the interface that the call names, so even override dispatch finds nothing (Figure 30 a). We write this hand-off once, as a rule for Java: a call to AuthenticationManager.authenticate runs AuthenticationProvider.authenticate . We apply it only when nothing else links the call, and link the call to the codebase’s implementation (Figure 30 b).
paragraphs.zh: 某些交接完全发生在库代码内部。 Spring Security 的登录过滤器调用 getAuthenticationManager().authenticate(req)，然后 Spring 的 ProviderManager 将请求传递给代码库自身的 AuthenticationProvider。 代码库并未实现该调用所指名的接口，因此即使是重写分派也找不到任何内容（图 30 a）。 我们将这种交接一次性写成一条 Java 规则：对 AuthenticationManager.authenticate 的调用会运行 AuthenticationProvider.authenticate。 我们只在没有其他方式链接该调用时应用此规则，并将该调用链接到代码库的实现（图 30 b）。

Some calls lead to several possible methods: a Java interface call has one Joern edge per implementing class, and override dispatch may find several implementations. Only one of them runs, and the graph does not say which, so we try each one separately and keep the one that reaches the most roles.
paragraphs.zh: 在多种方法之间进行选择。 某些调用会对应多个可能的方法：一次 Java 接口调用会为每个实现类生成一条 Joern 边，而重写分发可能找到多个实现。 其中只有一个会实际运行，而图中并未指明是哪一个，因此我们分别尝试每一种，并保留触达角色最多的那一个。

paragraphs.en: Figure 41 shows why P4 Session-based access control scores a low IRC in Java, on the codebase ncats/gsrs-spring-starter . The Authentication enforcer is the servlet filter’s doFilterInternal . It checks the session and then hands the request to Spring with filterChain.doFilter . The Authorisation enforcer is the @PreAuthorize annotation that UserController carries through @canManageUsers . Spring connects the two at run time, in framework code, and the annotation’s call to the Decider exists only inside a string. paragraphs.en: Scores. Under experiment_outputs/ , one evaluation.json per experiment, LLM and language holds the RDA, MLS and IRC of its 50 instances. Averaging them gives the scores of Section V ; for the full pipeline, the means over the four LLMs are an RDA of 0.84, an MLS of 0.84 and an IRC of 0.66. The secpat evaluate command of the SecPatRec repository recomputes these scores from the stored recoveries and the groundtruth, without calling any LLM. For the pipeline and the ablations, IRC derives the recovered interaction sequence S ^ \hat{S} from the role mapping on the same CPG and with the same traversal as the groundtruth; for the baseline, it scores the sequence that the LLM states in its answer.
